description: Actual original: burgundy knee-length wool tunic with restrained gold geometric trim at neckline, wrists and hem; pale linen collar/cuffs, decorated brown belt with hanging end and small side pouch, brown trousers and tall brown boots. Dark brown short mantle draped across shoulders with round brooch. Full standing figure in plain stone doorway with paved floor, no headgear, armor, weapon or scene banner visible.
